errors.409: Existing subscription: sign in to manage it

checkout.effects: Creates an unpaid Stripe Checkout Session and account record. Monitoring activates only after successful payment.
checkout.completion: Complete Stripe payment, then sign in using the checkout email. The API key is available in the authenticated dashboard.
checkout.cookie: The response sets an HttpOnly checkout cookie. Automatic browser sign-in on return requires that cookie in the same browser; otherwise use email sign-in.
checkout.idempotency: No public idempotency guarantee. Do not blindly retry session creation.
checkout.payment_link_note: No verified project Payment Link is published. Use the checkout API or the pricing page.

limitations: No ongoing DMARC aggregate (rua) or forensic (ruf) report ingestion
DKIM checks discover common selectors; no message-signature verification
Observed mail-server blocklists may not cover outbound sending IPs
No public paid-key provisioning endpoint; payment and email sign-in are required
